logoRules.note: Official Higgsfield mark only (lime tile #d1fe17 with #1a1a1a glyph), as published at static.higgsfield.ai. Never recreate, recolor, or rearrange it.

notes: Dark-first identity. Lime #d1fe17 is exact: it is the fill of the official logo SVG and the value of --hf-color-lime-500 / --hf-color-brand-primary in Higgsfield's official design tokens. Pink #ff005b (brand secondary) and cyan #9ce6f3 (brand tertiary) are exact official token values. UI neutrals are exact tokens (background #131416 = cool-400, surface #1c1e21 = cool-300, text #ffffff, muted #828282 = grey-300). Gradients, border width, radius and gap are design choices; see provenance. Inspired by Higgsfield's public identity; not a Higgsfield publication.

exact.description: Directly observed in official Higgsfield assets (logo SVG fills) or official design-token CSS served from assets.higgsfield.ai.

approximate.description: No exact brand-spec value observed; derived from the exact official tokens above.

values.backgroundGradient: Design derivation of background #131416 and cool neutrals; endpoint #0c0d0e is an estimate.
values.accentGradient: Design derivation between exact lime-500 #d1fe17 and lime-600 #b2d814.
values.borderWidth 2px, gap 40px, headlineWeigh: Template design choices, not brand values.

approximate.samplingMethod: Read official site HTML theme-color meta and downloaded the official design-token CSS from assets.higgsfield.ai; downloaded and sampled the official OG image (static.higgsfield.ai/ai-motion-designer/og.webp, 1200x676) with Python/PIL. The OG creative is a light marketing image (dominant #ffffff and exact #d1fe17) and was not used as the UI theme; the dark-first theme comes from the site's official tokens and theme-color (#030304 home, #0f1113 motion page).
